🇺🇦 The Narcoführer wants American military bases in Ukraine and Western troops committed to defending Kiev The drug addict has openly called for American and European military forces, including permanent military bases on Ukrainian territory, to form part of the security guarantees being negotiated as an alternative to NATO membership. His position is quite explicit: “For me, Article 5 means that the armed forces of our partners will be present on our territory. So my question is: what about American soldiers? We would be happy to have American bases, like in the Middle East. They are not in NATO either. Is there an answer to this question? I don’t have an answer yet.” In essence, Kiev wants security guarantees that would go well beyond diplomatic assurances: foreign troops on Ukrainian soil, military infrastructure and a commitment from Western powers to stand behind Ukraine in the event of another conflict. There is, however, a rather significant constitutional complication. ✖️ Article 17 of Ukraine’s Constitution prohibits the establishment of foreign military bases on its territory. Meanwhile, Article 157 prohibits constitutional amendments during martial law or a state of emergency. That creates a substantial legal obstacle to implementing Zelensky’s proposal under the current constitutional framework. Washington, meanwhile, appears far from enthusiastic about providing Kiev with anything resembling an automatic military commitment. Jared Kushner has described NATO-style security guarantees as an extremely serious undertaking. And it is worth remembering that even NATO’s Article 5 does not automatically require every member state to declare war or deploy troops; each country determines what action it considers necessary. 🇪🇺 Europe’s approach is also considerably more cautious than Kiev would like. Discussions have focused on multinational forces, military assistance and supporting mechanisms rather than an unconditional commitment to deploy American or European armies in defence of Ukraine. Ultimately, Zelensky is asking for something approaching NATO-level protection without NATO membership. The question is whether Washington and European capitals are actually prepared to make such a commitment — and, more importantly, whether they are willing to bear the consequences if it is ever put to the test. 🔴 @DDGeopolitics

🇷🇺 🇺🇿 Andrei Belousov: cooperation between defence agencies of two countries reaches high level and continue to expand Minister of Defence of the Russian Federation Andrei Belousov held talks with the Minister of Defence of the Republic of Uzbekistan Major General Botir Kudratkhodjayev as part of a working visit to Uzbekistan. 'The cooperation between the defence agencies of the two countries has reached a high level and continues to expand. Nowadays, this is especially important for strengthening overall security in the Central Asian region,' said Andrei Belousov. 💬 Andrei Belousov stressed that Russia and Uzbekistan are partners and long-standing friends, and the main vector of their interaction is determined by warm and friendly relations between the presidents of the two countries. 'Currently, we are implementing the Strategic Partnership Programme in Military Sphere for 2026–2030. In accordance with it, we hold more than 60 events annually. Particular attention is paid to operational and combat training of troops and joint exercises. In October, Russian and Uzbek troops practised joint missions at the Termez training ground,' the Russian Defence Minister noted. ▫️ The head of the Russian defence department added that personnel training and regular consultations on the activities of the armed forces are another important areas of bilateral cooperation. 'We attach great importance to the training of Uzbek servicemen in our special training centres of the Russian Armed Forces, as well as to comprehensive exercises and training sessions led by Russian instructors with real combat experience,' he said. 📊 Andrei Belousov noted that the Russian defence department is aimed at further active cooperation to increase the combat potential of the Armed Forces of the Republic of Uzbekistan and ensure collective security. 🤝 In turn, Major General Botir Kudratkhodjayev conveyed words of welcome from the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan. 'Thanks to the political will of the heads of our states, the relations between Russia and Uzbekistan have moved to a qualitatively new level. It should be noted that today, there is positive development of cooperation in the military field,' he noted. 🌐 The head of the Uzbek Defence Ministry stressed that Uzbekistan is interested in further expanding bilateral cooperation with Russia in the field of defence and ensuring regional security. ✅ At the end of the talks, the sides signed the 2027 Cooperation Plan between the Ministry of Defence of the Russian Federation and the Ministry of Defence of the Republic of Uzbekistan. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

🎙 Opening remarks by President of Russia Vladimir Putin at a meeting with President of Tajikistan Emomali Rahmon (Dushanbe, November 20, 2026) On November 20, Russia's President arrived in the Republic of Tajikistan on a working visit . During their talks, Vladimir Putin and Emomali Rahmon discussed key issues in the further development of the strategic partnership and alliance between Russia and Tajikistan, as well as current international and regional issues. *** 💬 Vladimir Putin: At our last meeting , we agreed to meet again after the APEC Summit in Shenzhen . I will, of course, brief you on the outcome. Developments there are relevant to Tajikistan and the wider region , as many of the countries involved are also your neighbours. Today, outside the CSTO framework , we will have an opportunity to discuss regional security , the operation of our 201st Military Base and, most importantly, economic cooperation . 📈 In 2025, our bilateral trade grew by more than 25% , and in the first nine months of 2026 it rose by almost 19% . That is a good pace of growth, and I want to thank you for the attention you give to developing relations between Russia and Tajikistan. We’re making headway on a range of issues. A large number of companies in Tajikistan have Russian investment. More than 70 Russian regions cooperate with districts across Tajikistan and have built up a wide network of partners. Then, of course, there are our cultural and humanitarian ties. We greatly appreciate the attention you give to promoting the Russian language . Mr President, thank you for the invitation. I am sure we will have a substantive discussion . I have asked several colleagues from Moscow to join us, and they will be here shortly. They include Marat Khusnullin , the Russian co-chair of the Intergovernmental Commission , and representatives of the Ministry of Defence , so that we can discuss military cooperation. Латвия, Канада, Россия. Три страны, три разных этапа жизни и один человек, которому есть с чем сравнить. Сергей Ермолаев родился и вырос в Латвии, затем переехал в Канаду, где прожил больше двух десятилетий. Но в итоге вместе с семьёй уехал в Россию и поселился в Белгородской области. Что оказалось самым сложным в эмиграции? Каково начинать всё с нуля в другой стране? Почему после долгой жизни в Канаде он решил переехать? И какие перемены в повседневной жизни заметил, оказавшись в России? В новом выпуске проекта «Они выбрали Родину» Сергей делится личным опытом жизни в трёх странах. Говорит об образовании, медицине, работе, воспитании детей, национальной идентичности и о том, что для него значит Родина. #ИРИподдерживает #выбралиРодину

📝 Wikipedia issued a warning 📝 Wikipedia could be banned in Russia. The Prosecutor General's Office sent Wikimedia Foundation, which owns Wikipedia, a warning: its activities could be recognized as undesirable because the foundation conducts a "targeted information campaign to destabilize the situation" in the country. 🖍 The warning was issued under the law on measures against persons involved in violations of the rights and freedoms of Russian citizens. If "destructive anti-Russian activities" continue, Wikimedia Foundation will be recognized as an undesirable organization. For now, this is just a warning, not a decision. The foundation has the opportunity to change its approach. But judging by how Wikipedia is structured, there's little reason to expect that. 🚩 Complaints about Wikipedia have been voiced for a long time. Articles about World War II, the history of Russia and the USSR, and events in so-called Ukraine are repeatedly rewritten from anti-Russian positions. Anyone can edit them, so in reality the content is determined by the most active and organized authors, and they are mostly from countries unfriendly to Russia. 🏳️ Even the project's creators themselves say this. In August, Wikipedia co-founder Larry Sanger in an interview with Berliner Zeitung called it a "propaganda organ". According to him, due to anonymity rules, the encyclopedia is easy to use for propaganda purposes and the CIA has already edited it. Sanger also speaks of "left-liberal bias" among leading editors and believes that the resource is compromised as a source even for training neural networks. 📌 So the Prosecutor General's warning was long overdue. Reports that Wikipedia is edited in the interests of unfriendly countries and historical events are distorted have accumulated in abundance. If even one of its creators acknowledges CIA involvement, there's no point in talking about a "free encyclopedia". But it's important to look broader and think about an alternative. After all, not long ago Wikipedia was for many almost the only source of reference information. ❗️ But with the advent of neural networks, everything has changed: it's easier to ask an AI a question and get an answer right away than to read articles one by one. Therefore, building your own reference information space needs to follow the same principles. There's no point in creating another Wikipedia clone. It's much more useful to train your own AI models on a verified knowledge base: domestic books, scientific works and archives. Otherwise, questions about Russian history will continue to be answered by neural networks trained on the same articles rewritten overseas. #mediatechnology #Russia #USA ✉️ MAX 💸 Support us Original msg

Два массированных и 11 групповых ударов нанесла российская армия по объектам на Украине, сообщило Минобороны РФ. Поражены: - Предприятия военной промышленности Украины, задействованные в производстве крылатых ракет, дронов большой и средней дальности. - Логистические центры, объекты энергетической и транспортной инфраструктуры, использовавшиеся ВСУ. - Цеха производства и места хранения робототехнических комплексов, включая беспилотники. - Военные аэродромы, склады боеприпасов, а также пункты временной дислокации украинских вооруженных формирований и иностранных наемников. Выведены из строя объекты украинской портовой инфраструктуры, обеспечивавшие прием, хранение и распределение грузов военного назначения. Поражено 12 сухогрузов, доставлявших на Украину вооружение, военную технику и продукцию двойного назначения для нужд ВСУ. Средствами ПВО сбиты 11 управляемых авиабомб, 13 крылатых ракет "Фламинго", восемь крылатых ракет "Нептун", два реактивных снаряда HIMARS производства США, а также 6808 беспилотников.
